sections.changelog:
Added

  • LocalBusiness (Schema.org) JSON-LD output for the front page, tuned for both Google and Yandex.
  • Business-type selector mapped to schema.org subtypes (deprecated `ProfessionalService` excluded).
  • Anti-duplicate integration: augments the existing Organization graph of Yoast (`wpseo_schema_organization`) or Rank Math (`rank_math/json_ld`) with the same `@id`; prints a standalone node only when no SEO plugin renders the graph.
  • Homepage schema scanner (AJAX + DOMDocument): detects an existing Organization/LocalBusiness node and its source before you create a duplicate.
  • Settings page on the MVweb Hub (UI Kit v2): identity, address, contacts, geo, weekly opening hours with presets and breaks, social/catalogue profiles, media, price range, payments, languages.
  • Opening hours builder with quick presets, per-day intervals and lunch breaks (`openingHoursSpecification`).
  • Special days (holidays / one-off closures) emitted as single-date closed specs (`validFrom`/`validThrough`, `opens` = `closes` = `00:00`).
  • Reviews handled via a trusted aggregator link only — no self-serving `aggregateRating` (Google policy).
  • Media picker (logo, facade, gallery) via the WordPress media modal.
  • Built-in validation links: Google Rich Results Test and Yandex Webmaster validator.
  • Messenger fields (WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, MAX) with format-tolerant input — a handle, a phone or a full link are all normalized.
  • Company identity, address, contacts and geo consolidated on a single "Company" tab; the "General" tab is a control panel (output toggle, homepage scan, validation links).
  • Asset cache-busting via file mtime.
